title: A Interior for the Blue Hour
author: Yara Nystrom
blurb: Hazel Winterbourne, a former prodigy returning to the conservatory as a janitor, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a box of undelivered letters surfaces behind a wardrobe — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the stranger in the old photographs, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
